pages.description: A list of the pages in the book.

raw.description: The plain text content of the page. The escape sequence {{cd|\n}} is used for line breaks. However, the [ [Brigadier|command parser] ] does not accept {{cd|\n}}, so line breaks need to be set by a [ [player] ] or using [ [loot table] ]s.<ref>{{bug|MC-119659}}</ref>

filtered.description: The filtered text of the page. Optional. Shown only to players with chat filter enabled, instead of {{nbt|string|text}}.

options.description: The plain text content of a page.

writable_book_content.description: The contents of this [ [book and quill] ].
